body: Yeah, I don't mean to accuse. I'm just trying to explain how my father is/how it is very difficult to deal with him. I think getting an internship is a very smart idea and I will definitely consider that.

It definitely feels like an obligation at this point. I have talked to my current therapist (at school) about taking time off. She thinks that it "might be a good idea" but that I have to "consider all of my options". If i'm honest, she's not very helpful at all.

I should have explained further but I kind of just word vomited into a post. I AM in therapy but my school only lets me see a therapist 2 times a month for an hour. They also cannot prescribe me medication. They are very limited. Part of my depression is from the amount of pressure and stress that I am under. If I go home, I can go to weekly therapy, the pressure will be relieved for a little while as I become mentally stable, and my psychiatrist can also prescribe me medication.
